module.purpose: Provides deterministic R2 object-key construction for rooms and snapshots, plus complete paginated listing of object keys.
module.summary: This utility module centralizes the R2 key namespace used for application and public rooms and composes snapshot keys from optional parent slugs. It also abstracts R2 pagination by repeatedly listing objects with a cursor until all keys have been collected, returning only key strings.
module.businessContext: Supports room and snapshot persistence in Cloudflare R2 for the sync worker. Incorrect key namespaces or incomplete pagination can make stored rooms inaccessible or cause synchronization to miss objects.
functions: getR2KeyForRoom (~L1-3): Builds the namespaced R2 key for a room.
getR2KeyForSnapshot (~L5-18): Builds an R2 key for a snapshot and optional parent.
listAllObjectKeys (~L20-31): Collects every object key across paginated R2 listings.

network: Calls the supplied R2 bucket's list operation for each pagination page.

detail.name: getR2KeyForSnapshot
detail.signature: export function getR2KeyForSnapshot({ parentSlug, snapshotSlug, isApp, }: { parentSlug: string | undefined | null; snapshotSlug: string; isApp: boolean; })
preconditions: parentSlug may be a string, null, or undefined.
postconditions: The room-key resolver is called with the snapshot slug alone when parentSlug is falsy.
The room-key resolver is called with `${parentSlug}/${snapshotSlug}` when parentSlug is truthy.
The isApp value is forwarded unchanged to the room-key resolver.
The resolver's result is returned unchanged.
invariants: A truthy parentSlug produces a slash-separated parent/snapshot slug.
A nullish or otherwise falsy parentSlug does not contribute a path segment.
edgeCases: When parentSlug is undefined, the snapshot slug is used without a parent prefix.
When parentSlug is null, the snapshot slug is used without a parent prefix.
When parentSlug is an empty string, it is treated as absent and the snapshot slug is used alone.
When parentSlug is non-empty, the resulting slug is `${parentSlug}/${snapshotSlug}`.
An empty snapshotSlug is accepted and forwarded as part of the composed slug.
detail.summary: Builds the R2 key for a snapshot by combining an available parent slug with the snapshot slug, then resolves the room key using the supplied app-mode flag.

specLiterals.role: Defines the slash-separated slug format when a parent slug is present.

It treats the parent slug as absent and resolves the room key using slug "snap-1".

detail.name: listAllObjectKeys
detail.signature: async function listAllObjectKeys(bucket: R2Bucket, prefix: string): Promise<string[]>
preconditions: bucket provides a list operation compatible with the R2Bucket API.
prefix is a string accepted by the bucket list operation.
postconditions: Returns an array containing the key of every object returned by all pages of bucket.list({ prefix, cursor }).
Keys are returned in the same order as the objects appear across successive list responses.
Returns an empty array when no listed page contains objects.
invariants: Each returned key corresponds to one object from a bucket-list response.
Objects are not transformed beyond extracting their key property.
Pagination continues only while the latest result is marked truncated and supplies a cursor.
edgeCases: An initial list result with no objects returns an empty array.
A non-truncated result returns its object keys without another list request.
A truncated result causes another list request using its cursor, and keys from later pages are appended.
An empty prefix is passed unchanged to bucket.list.
If bucket.list rejects, the rejection propagates and no fallback array is returned.

raises: The underlying error or rejection from bucket.list

stateMutations: Mutates the function-local keys array and pagination cursor.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Invokes bucket.list with { prefix: string, cursor: string | undefined }. Expects a result containing objects with key strings, a truncated boolean, and a cursor usable for the next request. Resolves to string[].
detail.summary: Lists all object keys in an R2 bucket matching the supplied prefix. It transparently follows paginated bucket-list responses and returns the keys in page order.

specTests.then: It calls bucket.list once with { prefix: "room/", cursor: undefined } and resolves to ["a", "b"].
It makes the second request with { prefix: "room/", cursor: "next" } and resolves to ["a", "b"].
